options: ① only
② only
①②
①④
②④
questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

① I woke up early so that I will not be late.
② He was so wisdom that he was able to solve it.
③ I took a taxi so that I could get there on time.
④ I've saved money to buy a computer.
⑤ I took my umbrella for my mother.
questions.explanation: ① woke up(과거)인데 will(현재/미래) = 시제 불일치. would not이 와야 합니다. ② wisdom은 명사이므로 "so wisdom"은 틀립니다. "so wise"(형용사)가 올바릅니다.

options: Our teacher brought a DVD so that we could watch a movie.
Giho made cookies so that we could eat them.
Hajin took pictures so that we could remember the day.
Tom couldn't get in so that he had left his ticket.
We sang a song so that she would know we loved her.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 so that의 쓰임이 흐름상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ④에서 "so that he had left his ticket"은 의미상 어색합니다. "들어갈 수 없었다"의 이유는 because이지 so that(목적)이 아닙니다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 짝지어진 것은?

(A) She is so wise that everyone respects her.
(B) He tried his best so that he can win the race.
(C) Speak too clearly that they can understand you.
(D) She was very careful so that she wouldn't drop the egg.
questions.explanation: (A) so + 형용사 + that = 결과 구문으로 올바릅니다. (D) so that + wouldn't = 목적절로 올바릅니다. (B) tried(과거) + can(현재) = 시제 불일치, (C) too → so가 되어야 합니다.

options: in order that get a good seat
so as to get a good seat
in order to they could get a good seat
so as to they could get a good seat
to they could get a good seat
questions.question:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분과 의미가 같은 것은?

They started early <u>so that they could get a good seat</u>.
questions.explanation: "so as to + 동사원형"은 목적을 나타내는 올바른 표현입니다. 나머지는 to/so as to 뒤에 주어+조동사가 와서 틀립니다.

options: I went to the store so as to buy some milk.
He studies hard in order that he can succeed.
I hurry so that I wouldn't miss the train.
She works hard so that her family can live in comfort.
Speak loudly so that everybody can hear you.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 곳이 있는 문장은?
questions.explanation: ③ hurry(현재)인데 wouldn't(과거) = 시제 불일치. "won't"이 와야 합니다.

options: I study hard <u>so that</u> I can pass.
He ran fast <u>so that</u> he could catch the bus.
I was <u>so</u> tired <u>that</u> I couldn't walk.
She saves money <u>so that</u> she can travel.
We use public transport <u>so that</u> we can save energy.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 나머지와 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ③은 "so + 형용사 + that"(결과 구문)이며, 나머지는 모두 "so that"(목적 구문)입니다.

options: He was so wisdom that he solved it.
I drove fast so that he can get there.
The kids practiced hard so as to win.
Jack skipped dinner in order that fit in jeans.
She's staying in US so that she can improves her English.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: ③ "so as to + 동사원형(win)"은 올바릅니다. ① wisdom → wise(형용사), ② drove(과거) + can(현재) = 시제 불일치, ④ in order that 뒤 주어 누락, ⑤ can + improves → can + improve.

options: Soyun was so careful that she wouldn't drop the egg.
Soyun was so careful but she wouldn't drop the egg.
Soyun was very careful so that she would drop the egg.
Soyun was so careful and she wouldn't drop the egg.
Soyun was very careful so that she wouldn't drop the egg.
questions.question:
[Part 4] 다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?

"소윤이는 계란을 떨어트리지 않기 위해 매우 조심했다."
questions.explanation: "~하기 위해"는 목적이므로 "so that + wouldn't"(⑤)가 올바릅니다. ① "so...that"은 결과 구문, ② but은 역접, ③ "would drop"은 긍정(떨어트리도록)으로 의미 반대, ④ and는 단순 연결입니다.

options: 나는 살을 빼기 위해 달린다. → I run so that I can lose weight.
그는 잊지 않기 위해 적었다. → He wrote it down so that he wouldn't forget.
그녀는 책을 읽기 위해 TV를 껐다. → She turned off the TV to read a book.
우리는 전망을 보기 위해 높이 올라갔다. → We went up high in order to see the view.
나는 그를 만나기 위해 여기 왔다. → I came here because I could meet him.
questions.question: 다음 중 영작이 바르지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: "만나기 위해"는 목적이므로 because(이유)가 아닌 to/so that이 와야 합니다.

options: I will change you so that you can meet the prince.
You will change I so that you can meet the prince.
I will change you so that the prince can meet you.
You will change so that I can meet the prince.
I will change the prince so that you can meet him.
questions.question:
다음 단어들을 바르게 배열한 것은?

(change, can, that, meet, I, will, you, so, the prince, you)
questions.explanation: "I will change you so that you can meet the prince."가 주어진 단어로 만들 수 있는 올바른 문장입니다.

options: Turn the light on so that I can see you.
Turn on the light so that you can see I.
I can see you so that turn the light on.
So that I can see you turn the light on.
Light turn on the so that I can see you.
questions.question:
다음 단어들을 바르게 배열한 것은?

(can, I, light, on, that, the, turn, see, so, you)
questions.explanation: "Turn the light on so that I can see you."가 올바른 배열입니다. ② "see I" → "see me"(목적격 오류).

options: Mom prepared breakfast so that I could rest.
I prepared breakfast so that Mom could rest.
So that Mom could rest I prepared breakfast.
Breakfast was prepared so that I could rest Mom.
I could rest so that Mom prepared breakfast.
questions.question:
다음 단어들을 바르게 배열한 것은?

(I, could, rest, prepared, so, Mom, breakfast, that)
questions.explanation: "I prepared breakfast so that Mom could rest."가 가장 자연스러운 문장입니다. 내가 아침을 준비해서 엄마가 쉴 수 있도록.

options: can
could
will
would
must
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 영어로 옮길 때 빈칸에 알맞은 조동사는?

"사막여우의 발은 뜨거운 모래 위를 걸을 수 있도록 털로 덮여 있다."

The fennec fox's feet are covered with fur so that it _______ walk on hot sand.
questions.explanation: 주절이 현재(are covered)이므로 so that절에도 현재형 조동사 can을 사용합니다.

options: I studied hard so that I could pass the exam.
I studied so hard that I could pass the exam.
So that I could pass the exam I studied hard.
I could pass the exam so that I studied hard.
I studied hard in order that pass the exam.
questions.question:
다음 단어들을 바르게 배열한 것은?

(studied, so, I, could, that, hard, I, the exam, pass)
questions.explanation: "I studied hard so that I could pass the exam."이 목적을 나타내는 올바른 배열입니다. ②는 "so hard that"(결과 구문)으로 의미가 다릅니다.

options: I pressed the button to turn on the computer.
Sora bought the book so that she could study English.
Junho turned off the light so that he could sleep well.
He went to India so that he could help the poor.
We should develop habits so that we live happy.
questions.question: 다음 중 영작이 어색한 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: ⑤ "so that" 뒤에 조동사(can)가 없고, "happy" → "happily"(부사) 또는 "live a happy life"가 되어야 합니다.

options: I go jogging to keep healthy.
I go jogging so as to keep healthy.
I go jogging in order to keep healthy.
I go jogging enough to keep healthy.
I go jogging so that I can keep healthy.
questions.question: 다음 중 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 하나는?
questions.explanation: ④ "enough to"는 "~할 만큼 충분히"라는 정도를 나타내며, 나머지는 모두 "건강을 유지하기 위해"라는 목적을 나타냅니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸 (가)~(라)에 들어갈 말을 <보기>에서 골라 순서대로 나열한 것은?

• Jenny is saving her money (가).
• He watches American movies (나).
• He went out the back door (다).
• She will go abroad (라).

<보기>
(A) so that he can improve listening
(B) so that nobody could see him
(C) so that she can fix her bike
(D) so that she can study art
questions.explanation: (가) saving money → fix her bike (C), (나) watches movies → improve listening (A), (다) went out back door → nobody could see (B), (라) go abroad → study art (D). 순서: C-A-B-D.

options: ① only
③ only
①②
①③
②③
questions.question:
다음 중 문장 전환이 바른 것끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

① I studied hard to pass. = I studied hard so that I could pass.
② He ran to catch the bus. = He ran so that he catch the bus.
③ She came early for us to start. = She came early so that we could start.
④ Turn on the light to see. = Turn on the light so that you see.
⑤ I woke up early not to be late. = I woke up early so that I won't be late.
questions.explanation: ① studied(과거) → so that I could pass 올바릅니다. ③ for us to start → so that we could start 올바릅니다. ② catch → could catch(조동사 누락), ④ you see → you can see(조동사 누락), ⑤ won't → wouldn't(woke up은 과거이므로 시제 불일치).

options: (A) so that - (B) could
(A) to - (B) could
(A) in order to - (B) can
(A) so that - (B) is
(A) because - (B) could
questions.question:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

He spoke slowly (A) _______ others (B) _______ understand him.
questions.explanation: 주절이 과거(spoke)이므로 so that + 주어 + could가 적절합니다.

options: I use a map so that I won't get lost.
She wears a coat so that she won't get cold.
He hurried so that he would miss the train.
I turned off the light so that I could sleep.
We save water so that we can protect nature.
questions.question: 다음 중 의미가 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: ③ "he would miss the train"(기차를 놓치도록)은 의미상 어색합니다. "wouldn't miss"(놓치지 않도록)가 되어야 합니다.

options: I'll wait here in order that you could find me.
He invented the phone in order that we can talk.
I went to bed early in order that I can wake up.
She studied hard in order that she passed the exam.
They ran fast in order that they can catch the bus.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
questions.explanation: ② 발명(과거)의 목적이 현재까지 지속되므로 can이 허용됩니다. ① will + could = 시제 혼용, ③ went(과거) + can(현재) = 불일치, ④ in order that + 과거형 동사(passed) = 조동사 필요, ⑤ ran(과거) + can(현재) = 불일치.

options: I exercise _______ stay healthy.
He ran fast _______ catch the bus.
I study hard _______ pass the test.
She went to the store _______ buy milk.
I save money _______ I can buy a car.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 하나는?
questions.explanation: ①~④는 "to/in order to/so as to + 동사원형" 형태이지만, ⑤는 주어(I) + 조동사(can)가 있으므로 "so that"이 필요합니다.
